name: Tomio Fukuda
source:
A neighbor of the Matsuno couple. He and his wife manages a real estate business. However, after Fukuda's wife hurt her arm, he asked Nariyuki if he could get his wife Mikoto to work part time for them, to which she agreed.

He is suffering from erectile dysfunction, but for some reason his manhood seems to react whenever looking at Mikoto. Back in his prime, he was known as a sexual prodigy at the brothels he used to frequent. He may be a pervert, but deep down he is a socially awkward man who is kind and considerate to others.
